title: Winning at the Radiology Podium: First-timer’s Guide to Crafting and Delivering a Memorable Conference Presentation
authors: Surbhi Raichandani, Shehbaz Ansari, Vera Sorin, B Bersu Ozcan, Pouria Rouzrokh
abstract: When practicing closer to the date of the conference, notice and smooth out any complicated phrases or awkward transitions to reduce the risk of stumbling during your talk. Your preparation is not complete until you also prepare for audience questions. Anticipate likely queries about key points or data and practice responses with mentors or peers to build confidence.
